I added `clever otoroshi open swaggerui [addon-id|addon-name]`. It opens `/docs/index.html?url=/bo/api/proxy/openapi` on the instance's access URL. I didn't run the command itself, because it needs an authenticated profile and a live Otoroshi add-on. `npm run fix-all` and `npm run validate` both pass.

The Swagger UI path is from my memory of how Otoroshi exposes its OpenAPI spec, and I haven't checked it against a real instance. Please open it once to confirm.

- **Command:** the new file is `src/commands/otoroshi/otoroshi.open.swaggerui.command.js`, and it's registered in `global.commands.js`. It uses `since: null`, so the release workflow sets the version.
- **Helper:** `operatorOpenSwaggerUi()` in `src/lib/operator-commands.js` does the work. It sits next to `operatorOpenWebUi`, so other operators could reuse it.
- **Generated docs:** `fix-all` regenerated `otoroshi.docs.md` and `skills/clever-tools/references/full-documentation.md`.
- **Dependencies:** `node_modules` was missing, so I ran `npm ci`.
- **Formatting:** `fix-all` reformatted `.claude/settings.json`, so I reverted that file.
- **Git:** I haven't committed anything.
